import pandas as pd

# Source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_88/test_0.csv"
]

# Target schema columns and types
target_columns = [
    'Airline', 'Date_of_Journey', 'Source', 'Destination', 'Route',
    'Dep_Time', 'Arrival_Time', 'Duration', 'Total_Stops',
    'Additional_Info', 'Price'
]

# Load all source tables (only one source in this case)
dfs = []
for file in source_files:
    # Read CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# Since the source schema matches exactly the target schema,
# we can union (concatenate) all source tables directly.
# Here, only one source table, so just use it directly.
df_all = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure columns are in the target schema order
df_all = df_all[target_columns]

# Convert Price to integer type explicitly (in case of any float or string)
df_all['Price'] = df_all['Price'].astype(int)

# Convert all other columns to string type as per target schema
for col in target_columns:
    if col != 'Price':
        df_all[col] = df_all[col].astype(str)

# Write the result to the target path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_88/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_all.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
